definition.name: nonvanishing-delta-projection
definition.definition: Byte-matched from refs/kitaev-2405.02434/approximate_algebras.tex (tex:918-930, displays delta_P / P_alternatives): P^\dag=P, ||P^2-P|| <= \delta; hence (1-\eps)||P||^2-\delta <= ||P|| <= (1+\eps)||P||^2+\delta, so ||P|| <= O(\delta) or | ||P||-1 | <= O(\delta+\eps); P is nonvanishing if the second alternative holds; nontrivial if both P and I-P are nonvanishing.
